description: Legacy Topology Penalty: life-cycle opportunity cost of preserving inherited overhead topology at undergrounding renewal
nearest_prior_work: Larsen (2016) LBNL method, eScholarship qt693823hn; NY DPS 2023 undergrounding report; Florida P1 undergrounding assessment
what_prior_work_does: Costs/benefits of converting overhead to underground along the SAME alignment; no comparison to redesigned topology
our_delta: Quantifies NPC_like-for-like - NPC_optimized under identical service constraints; formalizes renewal as a topology-decision point

description: Open-data-constrained legacy-network reconstruction with uncertainty propagated into optimization outcomes
nearest_prior_work: Standard practice: assume known utility topology (benchmark feeders) or a single heuristic reconstruction
what_prior_work_does: Uses observed/assumed topology as fixed input
our_delta: Generates M feasible reconstructions from roads+anchors and propagates reconstruction uncertainty into LTP
assessment: retain; needed for credibility (cannot claim observed topology)

description: Like-for-like vs redesigned underground network under identical service constraints
nearest_prior_work: Distribution expansion planning literature (e.g. Frontiers Energy Res. 2022 multi-stage MILP)
what_prior_work_does: Optimizes expansion of a given network; not the undergrounding-renewal decision
our_delta: Frames renewal as the rare moment topology can be re-chosen at civil-works cost

description: Whether DG siting/sizing changes the construction-vs-loss trade-off
nearest_prior_work: MDPI Energies 2022 MILP simultaneous reconfiguration + DG placement
what_prior_work_does: Co-optimizes reconfiguration and DG on an existing fixed network
our_delta: Tests joint topology+DG at renewal, incl. extended routing to resource locations

description: Topology-Loss Divergence between min-construction and min-loss solutions
nearest_prior_work: Network-design literature reports either cost- or loss-optimal designs separately
what_prior_work_does: Rarely quantifies structural divergence of the two optima
our_delta: Defines edge-set divergence metric with sensitivity to distance definition
assessment: retain as secondary; do not force if unstable
